definitions.explanation: Having an excessive desire for money, possessions, or other things. Always negative.

examples.japanese: {欲深|よくふか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われる→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{地主|じぬし}→地主：12048_jinushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{欲深|よくふか}くて⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: That landlord is known for being greedy.

examples.japanese: {欲深|よくふか}い⟦{王様|おうさま}→王様：01902_ousama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{民|たみ}→民：13246_tami⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搾|しぼ}り{取|と}った→搾り取る：14963_shiboritoru⟧。
examples.english: The greedy king squeezed taxes out of the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{欲深|よくふか}い⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧で、⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Humans are greedy creatures who never know satisfaction.

notes:
A compound i-adjective formed from ⟦{欲|よく}→欲：13183_yoku⟧ (desire, greed) + ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep). Describes someone whose desires run deep — excessively wanting money, power, or material things. Always used negatively.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "deep in desire." The compound structure is transparent: ⟦{欲|よく}→欲：13183_yoku⟧ (desire) + ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欲深|よくふか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a greedy person
- {欲深|よくふか}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: greedy eyes
- {欲深|よくふか}い⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧: a greedy merchant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貪欲|どんよく}→貪欲：08199_donyoku⟧な: greedy, covetous (more formal and literary)
- ⟦{強欲|ごうよく}→強欲：12507_gouyoku⟧な: avaricious, rapacious (stronger, more extreme)
- ⟦{欲張|よくば}り→欲張り：15920_yokubari⟧: greedy person, greediness (more colloquial noun/na-adjective)
- ⟦がめつい→がめつい：09413_gametsui⟧: greedy, stingy (very colloquial, Kansai origin)
